_comment: Human-cleared Tier-2 exceptions to check-spoiler-leak.py. Each entry is a secret-signaling phrase that is actually legitimate in-world public prose, not a leak. Keyed by content/-relative path, then the exact lowercased matched phrase, with a reason. Tier-1 author-terminology (gm-only, gm-notes, [!gm, 'the truth is otherwise', ...) is NEVER allowlistable. Ships empty; add entries as your own wiki needs them.
_comment_gm_role: OPTIONAL per-wiki spoiler strictness. Leave false (the default) for a single-GM, secret-heavy wiki, where the GM ROLE words (GM, Game Master, gamemaster, dungeon master) in player-facing prose read as author voice and are Tier 1. Set true only for an open table whose premise IS a rotating GM pool, where the role word is ordinary player vocabulary. This flag NEVER affects the author markers above, which stay Tier 1 regardless.
